title: Replace a damaged pocket on a Haas side-mount tool changer (SMTC)
scope: Pocket replacement demonstrated in SRC_HAAS_0005; the machine model is not stated.

manufacturer.note: Named in the source title; publisher is Haas Automation, Inc.

machine_family.note: Not stated. A VM-3 sign is visible behind the presenter in the intro, but the video never says the repair is done on that machine.

machine_model.note: Not stated in the narration or title.

subsystem.note: Named in the narration (U0001-U0002) and the title.

task_type.note: Team label: part replacement. Schema 1.0.0 has no separate 'repair' task type.

components.note: Only parts named in the narration.

steps.title: Bring the damaged pocket into position and press E-stop

context.text: The procedure replaces a damaged pocket on the side-mount tool changer.
context.explanation: The presenter states the task at the start of the video.

action.text: The presenter says to set the rapids down to 25% and then rotate to the damaged pocket.
action.explanation: The caption states both instructions in one sentence.

action.text: The presenter says to press E-stop.

condition.text: The presenter says E-stop is pressed once the pocket is in position.
condition.explanation: The caption gives 'once the pocket is in position' as the moment to press E-stop.

questions.question: Why are the rapids set down to 25% before rotating to the damaged pocket?

steps.title: Remove the top fasteners and the cam-box sheet metal

action.text: The presenter says three pieces of sheet metal are removed from the bottom of the cam box: a larger piece and two smaller pieces right below the double arm.
action.explanation: The caption names the three pieces and where they are.

rationale.text: The presenter says the sheet metal is removed to gain access to the damaged pocket and the switches behind it.
rationale.explanation: The caption gives the reason with 'in order to gain access to'.

condition.text: The presenter says four fasteners on top of the machine must be removed before the larger panel can be moved.
condition.explanation: The caption says 'before we can move this larger panel there are four of those fasteners on top of the machine'.

steps.title: Remove the tools and mark the carousel disk

action.text: The presenter says all tools are removed from the carousel and their locations are marked.
The presenter says a mark is put on the carousel disk and on the pocket.
action.explanation: The caption states where the marks go.

rationale.text: The presenter says the tools are removed because they will be working in this area for a few minutes.
rationale.explanation: The caption links the two with 'so'.

rationale.text: The presenter says the marks are made so the carousel disk is reinstalled correctly.
rationale.explanation: The caption says 'we want to make sure we installed it carousel disk correctly so we'll put a mark ... for reinstallation'.

steps.title: Remove the number ring, disconnect main air and remove the pilot check valve

action.text: The presenter says the number ring is removed.
The presenter says the main air to the machine is disconnected.
action.explanation: The caption states the instruction across two cues.

action.text: The presenter says the pilot check valve is removed.

outcome.text: The presenter says that with the check valve removed he can move the pocket up and down freely.
outcome.explanation: The caption states the result of removing the check valve.

questions.question: Why is the main air disconnected at this point in the procedure?

steps.title: Remove the pocket stop, shoulder bolt, retaining bolt and pocket

action.text: The presenter says the four bolts are removed from the pocket stop.
The presenter says the shoulder bolt on the back side of the carousel, next to the lower proximity switch, is removed.
action.explanation: The caption names the bolt and where it is.

action.text: The presenter says the retaining bolt is then removed and the pocket is taken out.

rationale.text: The presenter says the pocket stop is removed so that removal of the pocket can continue.
rationale.explanation: The caption links the two with 'so we can continue with it removal of the pocket'.

steps.title: Check the cam follower and plungers

action.text: The presenter says to rotate the cam follower.
In the video, gloved hands hold the removed pocket and grip its cam follower.

attribution.label: D1-B keyframe observation, pending human check

evidence.observation_note: Close-up: two gloved hands hold a machined metal pocket part; one hand grips a cylindrical roller at its end.
evidence.explanation: The frame shows the part being handled.

action.explanation: The narration at the same moment names the roller as the cam follower.

action.text: The presenter says to check the plungers inside the pocket.

acceptance_criteria.text: The presenter says the cam follower should be spinning freely.
acceptance_criteria.explanation: The caption says 'make sure that it's spinning freely'.

acceptance_criteria.text: The presenter says the plungers should not be worn out.
acceptance_criteria.explanation: The caption says 'make sure they're not worn out'.

questions.question: What should be done if the cam follower does not spin freely or the plungers are worn?

steps.title: Grease the slider and install the new pocket

action.text: The presenter says grease is applied to the pocket slider.
The presenter says the pocket is installed onto the slider and both are installed back in position.
The presenter says the retaining bolt is reinstalled and tightened.
action.explanation: The caption says 'reinstall it retainer bolt and tighten it'.

action.text: The presenter says the pocket is lowered and the shoulder bolt is attached and screwed in.
action.explanation: The caption first reads 'shoulder boat', then 'attach the shoulder bolt' in the same sentence.

questions.question: Which grease is used, and what tightening torque applies to the retaining bolt and the shoulder bolt?

action.text: The presenter says he is reading the pocket up and pocket down switches.

outcome.text: The presenter says the pocket is now moving freely.

questions.question: What pocket up and pocket down switch readings confirm the new pocket is installed correctly?

steps.title: Reinstall the pocket stop, check valve and number disc

action.text: The presenter says the pocket stop is installed.
The presenter says the check valve is installed.
The presenter says the number disc is reinstalled by lining up the dot on the number disc with the dot on the pocket.
action.explanation: The caption states how the disc is aligned.

steps.title: Reinstall the panels and the tools

action.text: The presenter says the remaining three panels are installed.
The presenter says the tools are installed once the panels are all in place.
action.explanation: The caption states the instruction and its timing.

condition.text: The presenter says the test is run with the new pocket installed, the panels secured and the main air turned on.
condition.explanation: The caption lists the state of the machine before the test.

action.text: The presenter says to release the E-stop and run the tool changer through several tool changes.
action.explanation: The caption reads 'several two changes'; the sentence is about running the tool changer, so it is taken as 'tool changes'.

acceptance_criteria.text: The presenter says the tool changes are run to ensure everything is working correctly.
acceptance_criteria.explanation: The caption states the purpose of the test run.

questions.question: How many tool changes should be run, and what counts as 'working correctly'?

claim.text: The presenter says the cam follower and plunger checks are made before the new pocket is installed.
claim.explanation: The caption says 'before we install the new pocket there's a few things we need to check'.
